query:
WITH latest_snapshot AS (
  SELECT MAX(snapshot) as max_snap 
  FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala
),
population_25plus AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT hp.id, hp.gender, hl.city, d.head_of_household_id
  FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala hp
  JOIN estishraf_llm_home_location hl ON hp.id = hl.id
  JOIN estishraf_llm_demographics_impala d ON hp.id = d.id
  CROSS JOIN latest_snapshot ls
  WHERE hp.snapshot = ls.max_snap
    AND hp.is_in_population = TRUE
    AND hp.age >= 25
    AND hl.city IN ('الرياض', 'جدة')
),
highest_edu AS (
  SELECT id, qualification,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY 
      CASE qualification 
        WHEN 'دكتوراه' THEN 1
        WHEN 'زمالة' THEN 2
        WHEN 'ماجستير' THEN 3
        WHEN 'بكالوريوس' THEN 4
        WHEN 'دبلوم عال' THEN 5
        WHEN 'دبلوم متوسط' THEN 6
        ELSE 7
      END) as rn
  FROM estishraf_llm_university_graduates_impala
  WHERE graduation_date IS NOT NULL
),
enriched_pop AS (
  SELECT p.id, p.city, p.head_of_household_id, he.qualification
  FROM population_25plus p
  LEFT JOIN highest_edu he ON p.id = he.id AND he.rn = 1
),
with_wealth AS (
  SELECT ep.city, ep.qualification, w.wealth_level
  FROM enriched_pop ep
  JOIN estishraf_llm_wealth_index w ON ep.head_of_household_id = w.head_of_household_id
)
SELECT city, wealth_level, qualification, COUNT(*) as count
FROM with_wealth
GROUP BY city, wealth_level, qualification
ORDER BY city, wealth_level, count DESC
LIMIT 200
